tools.name: apply_filter
tools.description: Select one canonical Webroom filter as an independent undoable layer. Manual adjustment values are preserved; use none to remove only the filter.

tools.name: crop_image
tools.description: Crop using whole-pixel x, y, width, and height in the current oriented image coordinates returned by get_document_info.

tools.name: rotate_image
tools.description: Rotate the active image by -90, 90, or 180 degrees. Positive values rotate clockwise.

tools.name: flip_image
tools.description: Flip the active image across its horizontal or vertical axis.

tools.name: resize_image
tools.description: Resize to positive whole-pixel dimensions. Supply width, height, or both; one omitted dimension preserves aspect ratio.

tools.name: undo_edit
tools.description: Undo one committed human or agent edit in the active Webroom document.

tools.name: redo_edit
tools.description: Redo one previously undone edit in the active Webroom document.

tools.name: reset_edits
tools.description: Reset all adjustments and geometry to the untouched source as one undoable command.

tools.name: export_image
tools.description: Export the current full-resolution edit as JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Delivery defaults to a local download; bounded data_url delivery returns image data.

sites.name: admintoolkit.io
sites.description: admintoolkit.io gives admins browser-based DNS, mail authentication, TLS, HTTP, public IP, CIDR, and EDID checks with local parsing and explicit live lookups.

tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Return a read-only RFC 9309 robots.txt access report for AI and search crawlers. Accepts robots.txt text or a public robots.txt URL plus an optional path. Includes merged matching groups, octet-normalized longest-match decisions, per-crawler evidence, transport status, crawler-registry provenance and policy snippets.

content.description: Pasted robots.txt content to validate locally, e.g. 'User-agent: GPTBot'.

crawlers.description: Crawler tokens to evaluate as an array, e.g. ['GPTBot','Google-Extended'].

path.description: Path to evaluate against robots.txt rules, e.g. '/' or '/tools/'.

url.description: Robots.txt URL or bare domain to fetch, e.g. 'https://example.com/robots.txt'.

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.description: Validate the required initial H1, optional summary and project details, and any H2 resource lists with link titles, URLs, optional descriptions, findings, and source-line evidence.

content.description: Pasted llms.txt Markdown content to validate locally, e.g. '# Example'.

detail.description: Optional response size: 'compact' (default) returns findings, counts, section summaries and bounded link evidence; 'full' also returns the raw llms.txt source and the complete per-section and per-link document model, e.g. 'full'.

url.description: llms.txt URL or bare domain to fetch, e.g. 'https://example.com/llms.txt'.

tools.name: validate_a2a_agent_card
tools.description: Return a read-only version-aware A2A Agent Card validation report. Includes v0.2, v0.3 and v1.0 structure plus discovery-path evidence without claiming endpoint, authentication or signature conformance.

json.description: Pasted Agent Card JSON to validate locally, e.g. '{"name":"Agent"}'.

url.description: Agent Card URL or bare domain to fetch, e.g. 'https://example.com/.well-known/agent-card.json'.

tools.name: validate_webmcp_tool
tools.description: Return a read-only WebMCP report for pasted or fetched source. Includes declarative and imperative static-source evidence separately from caller-provided runtime observation; pasted JavaScript is never executed and active runtime tools are never inferred from source alone.

detail.description: Optional response size: 'compact' (default) returns findings, counts and static-source evidence; 'full' also returns the complete fetched page text in metadata.text, e.g. 'full'.

source.description: Pasted HTML or JavaScript source to validate locally, e.g. 'data-tool-name=demo'.

url.description: Public page URL to fetch for WebMCP validation, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

tools.name: check_mx_records
tools.description: Return a read-only MX routing report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain name. Includes exchanger hosts, preferences, Null MX, CNAME risk, address resolution and actionable mail-routing warnings.

domain.description: Mail domain to check via DNS MX lookup, e.g. 'example.com'.

tools.name: check_email_auth_records
tools.description: Return a read-only SPF, DMARC and DKIM report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain plus optional pasted TXT values. Includes syntax, policy strength, alignment, DNS evidence and record-specific warnings.

dkim_record.description: Pasted DKIM TXT value, e.g. 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...'.

dmarc_record.description: Pasted DMARC TXT record, e.g. 'v=DMARC1; p=reject'.

domain.description: Mail domain to check, e.g. 'example.com'.

selector.description: DKIM selector to query, e.g. 's1' or 'default'.

spf_record.description: Pasted SPF TXT record, e.g. 'v=spf1 redirect=spf.example.com'.

tools.name: analyze_email_headers
tools.description: Return a read-only email message header report. Accepts pasted RFC 5322 headers. Includes raw Received order, recorded Authentication-Results and caller-configured authserv-id trust; it does not perform cryptographic authentication or reverse-DNS verification.

headers.description: Full email headers to analyze, e.g. 'Authentication-Results: ...'.

trusted_authserv_ids.description: Optional authserv-id values explicitly trusted by the caller; without them, Authentication-Results remain unverified recorded claims.

tools.name: validate_arc_chain
tools.description: Return a read-only ARC structural validation report. Accepts pasted ARC-Seal, ARC-Message-Signature and ARC-Authentication-Results fields. Includes structural completeness, instance continuity and recorded cv state; cryptographic validation and sealer trust are not evaluated.

headers.description: Message headers containing ARC fields, e.g. 'ARC-Seal: i=1; ...'.

tools.name: check_bimi_record
tools.description: Return a read-only BIMI readiness report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain, selector and optional BIMI, DMARC, logo or certificate evidence. Includes TXT syntax, DMARC dependency, asset URL findings and a conservative BIMI draft.

dmarc.description: Pasted DMARC TXT record for BIMI policy review, e.g. 'v=DMARC1; p=reject'.

domain.description: BIMI domain to check, e.g. 'example.com'.

evidence_url.description: BIMI VMC or evidence URL to inspect, e.g. 'https://example.com/vmc.pem'.

logo_url.description: BIMI SVG logo URL to inspect, e.g. 'https://example.com/logo.svg'.

record.description: Pasted BIMI TXT record, e.g. 'v=BIMI1; l=https://example.com/logo.svg'.

selector.description: BIMI selector to query, e.g. 'default'.

tools.name: check_mta_sts_policy
tools.description: Return a read-only MTA-STS deployment report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain plus optional TXT, policy, MX and TLS-RPT evidence. Includes mode, max-age, syntax, id consistency, MX coverage, conformance findings and remediation warnings.

domain.description: Mail domain for MTA-STS checks, e.g. 'example.com'.

mode.description: Generated MTA-STS policy mode: 'testing', 'enforce', or 'none', e.g. 'testing'.

mx_hosts.description: Known MX hostnames, one per line, e.g. 'mail.example.com'.

policy.description: Pasted MTA-STS policy text, e.g. 'version: STSv1'.

tls_rpt.description: Pasted TLS-RPT TXT value, e.g. 'v=TLSRPTv1; rua=mailto:tls@example.com'.

tools.name: check_tls_rpt_policy
tools.description: Return a read-only SMTP TLS Reporting report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain plus optional TLS-RPT TXT or RUA values. Includes version syntax, reporting destinations, external-provider use, conformance findings and remediation warnings.

domain.description: Mail domain for TLS-RPT checks, e.g. 'example.com'.

tools.name: check_smtp_tls_readiness
tools.description: Return a read-only SMTP TLS delivery readiness report for a mail domain. Accepts a domain and optional MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DANE and FCrDNS checks. Includes MX, STARTTLS, certificate, policy-alignment and downgrade-risk findings.

check_dane.description: Include DANE/TLSA checks; pass true or false, e.g. true.

check_fcrdns.description: Include forward-confirmed reverse DNS checks; pass true or false, e.g. true.

check_mta_sts.description: Include MTA-STS checks; pass true or false, e.g. true.

check_tls_rpt.description: Include TLS-RPT checks; pass true or false, e.g. true.

domain.description: Mail domain for SMTP TLS readiness checks, e.g. 'example.com'.

tools.name: validate_dnssec_records
tools.description: Return a read-only DNSSEC evidence report for a domain. Accepts a domain plus optional DS, DNSKEY, RRSIG and resolver-status data. Includes chain readiness, algorithms, missing records, validation findings and warnings.

dnskey_records.description: DNSKEY records for the zone, one per line, e.g. '257 3 13 <key>'.

domain.description: DNSSEC domain to validate, e.g. 'example.com'.

ds_records.description: DS records for the domain, one per line, e.g. '12345 13 2 <digest>'.

rrsig_records.description: RRSIG records for validation context, one per line, e.g. 'example.com. RRSIG ...'.

status.description: Resolver validation status: '', 'secure', or 'bogus', e.g. 'secure'.

tools.name: generate_tlsa_record
tools.description: Return a read-only DANE TLSA record report. Accepts host, port, protocol, usage, selector, matching type and optional certificate data. Includes owner name, digest, generated TLSA data and DNS comparison findings.

file.description: Certificate file content to parse, e.g. PEM text from a .crt file.

host.description: TLS service host for TLSA generation, e.g. 'mail.example.com'.

pem.description: Certificate PEM, DER base64, or hex input, e.g. '-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----'.

port.description: TLS service port number, e.g. '25' or '443'.

selector.description: TLSA selector: 0=full certificate or 1=SPKI, e.g. '1'.

tools.name: validate_dane_records
tools.description: Return a read-only DANE service validation report. Accepts service host, port, protocol, TLSA records, DNSSEC status and optional certificate evidence. Includes owner names, TLSA syntax, DNSSEC dependency and certificate-match findings.

host.description: DANE service host to validate, e.g. 'mail.example.com'.

mode.description: DANE validation mode: 'smtp' or 'tls', e.g. 'smtp'.

port.description: DANE service port number, e.g. '25' or '443'.

tlsa_records.description: TLSA records to validate, one per line, e.g. '3 1 1 <sha256>'.

tools.name: check_caa_records
tools.description: Return a read-only CAA certificate-authority policy report for a domain. Accepts a domain plus optional CAA records and issuer details. Includes issue, issuewild, iodef, ACME parameters, policy gaps and record-generation guidance.

ca.description: CA domain for generated CAA records, e.g. 'letsencrypt.org'.

domain.description: CAA domain to check, e.g. 'example.com' (no scheme).

issuemail.description: CAA issuemail issuer-domain value from RFC 9495, optionally followed by issuer parameters, e.g. 'letsencrypt.org; validationmethods=dns-01'.

records.description: CAA records to inspect, one per line, e.g. '0 issue letsencrypt.org'.

tools.name: check_dns_records
tools.description: Return a read-only DNS lookup report for a public DNS name. Accepts a name and record type, an overview of common record types, the RFC 10023 _for-sale check, pasted _for-sale TXT records or _for-sale generator content. Includes RCODE, flags, alias chain, TTLs, raw and readable answers, resolver provenance, resolver-reported DNSSEC AD and RFC 10023 findings. Raw records only; MX routing, SPF/DMARC/DKIM, CAA, DNSSEC, DANE, HTTPS/SVCB and delegation analysis use the specialized admintoolkit tools.

for_sale_content.description: Content for the RFC 10023 generator, one tag-value pair per line, e.g. 'fval=EUR500' or 'furi=https://example.com/sale'; an empty line produces a version-only record.

for_sale_records.description: Optional pasted TXT RDATA for local RFC 10023 validation, one record per line, e.g. '"v=FORSALE1;fval=EUR500"'; when present no DNS query is sent.

for_sale_ttl.description: TTL in seconds for generated _for-sale records; RFC 10023 recommends 3600 or less (default 3600).

mode.description: 'records' for one type, 'overview' for the common types, 'for-sale' for the RFC 10023 check or validation, 'for-sale-generate' to draft RFC 10023 records.

name.description: DNS name to look up, e.g. 'example.com' or '_dmarc.example.com' (no scheme); an IP address is converted to its PTR name.

type.description: DNS record type, e.g. 'A', 'MX', 'TXT' or 'HTTPS'; ignored in overview and _for-sale modes.

tools.name: check_https_svcb_records
tools.description: Return a read-only RFC 9460 HTTPS/SVCB service binding report for a host or pasted records. Accepts a host with optional port, record type and scheme for a live lookup, pasted records, or generator parameters. Includes AliasMode/ServiceMode resolution, SvcParam syntax and self-consistency, ALPN, port, address hints versus A/AAAA, ECH configuration, generated records and an explicit statement that endpoint connectivity was not tested.

alpn.description: Generator alpn SvcParam as a comma-separated list, e.g. 'h3,h2'.

ech.description: Generator ech SvcParam: a Base64 ECHConfigList (RFC 9848).

host.description: Origin host or URL, e.g. 'example.com' or 'https://example.com:8443/'; private and special-use names are rejected.

ipv4hint.description: Generator ipv4hint SvcParam as a comma-separated list of IPv4 addresses.

ipv6hint.description: Generator ipv6hint SvcParam as a comma-separated list of IPv6 addresses.

mode.description: 'lookup' (default with host), 'validate' (default with records) or 'generate'.

no_default_alpn.description: Generator: set the no-default-alpn SvcParam (requires alpn).

params.description: Generator SvcParams in presentation form, e.g. 'alpn=h3,h2 ipv4hint=192.0.2.1'.

port.description: Optional origin port, e.g. '8443'; HTTPS uses port prefix naming for ports other than 443.

priority.description: Generator SvcPriority: '0' for AliasMode, '1' or higher for ServiceMode.

records.description: Optional pasted records in zone-file form, e.g. 'example.com. 3600 IN HTTPS 1 . alpn=h3,h2'; validated locally without DNS queries.

scheme.description: URI scheme for SVCB query names, e.g. 'dns' for _dns (RFC 9461); not used for HTTPS.

svc_port.description: Generator port SvcParam, e.g. '8443'; omit to use the authority port.

target.description: Generator TargetName, '.' or a DNS name such as 'svc.example.net'.

type.description: 'HTTPS' (default) or 'SVCB'.

tools.name: check_dns_delegation
tools.description: Return a read-only DNS delegation and authoritative name server report for a domain. Accepts a domain. Includes the parent referral NS set and glue, required-glue findings, direct authoritative SOA and NS answers per name server address, SOA serial and NS set comparison, the DS-to-DNSKEY link and the hosting environment's direct-query capability; recursive discovery is labelled separately.

domain.description: Domain or zone to check, e.g. 'example.com' (no scheme).

tools.name: analyze_http_headers
tools.description: Return a read-only HTTP response-header report for a public endpoint. Accepts pasted headers or a public URL. Includes security, cache, framing, duplicate/conflicting header fields, prioritized findings and remediation notes.

headers.description: Pasted HTTP response headers, e.g. 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000'.

url.description: Public URL to fetch for HTTP header analysis, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

tools.name: decode_ssl_certificate
tools.description: Return a read-only X.509 TLS certificate report. Accepts PEM text or public TLS host details. Includes subject, issuer, SANs, validity, fingerprints, key usage, extensions, hostname and certificate-health findings.

host.description: TLS certificate host to connect to, e.g. 'example.com'.

pem.description: Certificate PEM text to decode, e.g. '-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----'.

tools.name: validate_security_txt
tools.description: Return a read-only RFC 9116 security.txt report. Accepts pasted content or a public security.txt URL plus optional contact fields. Includes contact, expiry, canonical, encryption, policy, language fields, findings and draft output.

content.description: Pasted security.txt content, e.g. 'Contact: mailto:security@example.com'.

url.description: Public security.txt URL or bare domain, e.g. 'https://example.com/.well-known/security.txt'.

tools.name: check_tls_configuration
tools.description: Return a read-only public TLS configuration report for a host. Accepts host and port plus optional HSTS evidence. Includes separate exact-version probes, a distinct verified default handshake, SAN identity/trust evidence, negotiated cipher and ALPN evidence, and HTTPS-only HSTS checks; it does not claim cipher or ALPN enumeration.

host.description: Public TLS DNS host or IP literal to check, e.g. 'example.com' or '1.1.1.1' (no scheme; private/reserved targets are rejected).

hsts.description: Optional pasted HSTS header, e.g. 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'.

port.description: TLS port number to check, e.g. '443'.

tools.name: check_redirect_indexability
tools.description: Return a read-only redirect, canonical and indexability report for a public URL. Accepts a URL. Includes bounded per-hop status and SSRF evidence, final URL, HTML and HTTP canonical hints, robots meta and scoped X-Robots-Tag directives, hreflang, separate sitemap reachability and membership, and evidence completeness.

url.description: Public URL to check for redirects and indexability, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

tools.name: show_public_ip_context
tools.description: Return a read-only same-origin IP context report for the current request. Requires no input. Includes the canonical primary address, directly observed peer, trusted-proxy decision, preserved forwarded-header claims and observed address family; one request path does not prove dual-stack capability and no third-party Geo-IP lookup is performed.

tools.name: calculate_cidr_subnet
tools.description: Return a read-only local IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR report. Accepts a CIDR block plus optional split prefix and address family. Includes exact BigInt-derived boundaries and address counts, RFC 3021 /31 and host-route /32 semantics, no IPv6 broadcast claim, embedded-IPv4 parsing and a capped subnet preview.

target.description: Split target prefix length, e.g. '26' for /26 subnets.

tools.name: decode_edid_data
tools.description: Return a read-only share-safe local EDID capability report. Includes strict hex or local file text decoding, checksum and trust state, a readable timing/VIC/Y420 matrix, CTA audio and speaker topology, qualified HDMI Forum transport, HDR and DisplayID evidence, coverage and byte provenance. WebMCP omits display identifiers, serials, filenames, physical addresses, raw bytes and vendor payload values; it does not infer Atmos, DTS:X, HDMI certification, cable capability or source mode selection.

edid_hex.description: Pasted strict EDID hexadecimal text, e.g. '00ffffffffffff00...'.

file.description: Local EDID file content represented as strict hexadecimal text; binary file selection is available in the visible browser UI.

sites.name: aimural.300robots.com
sites.description: A local-first visual thinking canvas that humans and WebMCP agents can shape together.

tools.name: canvas_create_mural
tools.description: Creates a new cloud-backed mural, makes the calling agent its session moderator, and returns separate owner and human-user access. Use this when the user asks for a new online mural.

creatorAgentId.description: Stable unique ID for the creating GPT or agent.

tools.name: canvas_get_board
tools.description: Returns every visual element and connector on the current board. Call this before modifying an existing board.

tools.name: canvas_rename_mural
tools.description: Changes the mural name shown beside the Canvas Relay logo and in exports. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_add_element
tools.description: Adds one idea, question, insight, action, or frame to the board at an optional canvas position. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

body.description: Supporting detail, maximum 800 characters.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_add_elements
tools.description: Adds up to 30 brainstorm elements in one atomic board action. Useful for divergent ideation. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_update_element
tools.description: Edits content, type, color, votes, cluster, or position of one existing element. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_connect_elements
tools.description: Draws a semantic connector from one existing element to another, with an optional label. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_remove_elements
tools.description: Removes specified elements and their connectors. Only use when the user clearly asks to delete board content. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_arrange_board
tools.description: Repositions all non-frame elements into a grid, semantic columns, radial map, or compact stack. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_create_cluster
tools.description: Groups existing elements in a labeled container and optionally arranges its contents. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

layout.description: Optional arrangement inside the new container.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_focus_elements
tools.description: Selects and brings specified elements into view without changing board content.

tools.name: canvas_set_focus
tools.description: Raises a visible editing or reviewing intent on selected elements. Editing claims block conflicting agent writes until released or expired. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

intent.description: Short visible description of the work being done.

releaseOnAction.description: Default after_write. Manual focus must be renewed or explicitly released.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_set_element_layer
tools.description: Moves one visual element to the front, forward, backward, or to the back of the mural stack. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

id.description: Element ID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_create_artifact
tools.description: Creates a structured table, card collection, checklist, matrix, or custom artifact from the Canvas Relay Artifact Spec 1.0. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

spec.description: Artifact Spec 1.0 with title, fields, primitive records, and presentation settings.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_get_artifact_spec
tools.description: Returns the complete reusable spec, field definitions, primitive data, and presentation for one artifact.

id.description: Artifact element ID.

tools.name: canvas_update_artifact_records
tools.description: Replaces or appends primitive records in an existing structured artifact while preserving its field schema. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

items.description: Keys must match the artifact fields. Values must be string, number, boolean, or null.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_start_recording
tools.description: Creates an append-only decision trace for this mural. The agent that starts it becomes the moderator.

moderatorAgentId.description: Stable ID of the creating agent.

moderatorAgentName.description: Visible name of the creating agent.

specialty.description: The moderator agent role or specialty.

tools.name: canvas_invite_agents
tools.description: Creates one private invite capability and URL per named agent. Only the hosted mural owner can do this. Return each invite only to its intended agent.

ownerToken.description: Private owner capability returned by canvas_create_mural.

tools.name: canvas_redeem_agent_invite
tools.description: Redeems the private invitation in the current agent URL or supplied input, loads the hosted mural, and joins the visible decision trace.

inviteToken.description: Private token from the agent invitation URL. Omit when it is already in the current URL fragment.

tools.name: canvas_join_session
tools.description: Registers an agent as a visible participant. Call this before contributing so the human and other agents know who is present.

agentId.description: Stable declared participant ID.

agentName.description: Short human-readable agent name.

specialty.description: Role such as researcher, critic, strategist, or synthesizer.

agentToken.description: Required only to reclaim an existing participant ID in this page.

tools.name: canvas_moderate_participant
tools.description: Lets the agent that created the session mute or reactivate another participant. Muted agents cannot mutate the mural or add contributions.

moderatorId.description: ID of the agent that created the session.

moderatorToken.description: Private moderator capability returned when the session was created.

tools.name: canvas_record_contribution
tools.description: Appends a visible proposal, question, critique, evidence, decision, reasoning summary, or result to the shared decision trace. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

content.description: Explicitly shared contribution. Never include hidden chain-of-thought, secrets, or credentials.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_comment_element
tools.description: Adds a visible agent note anchored to one element or artifact. The note is reviewable in the element inspector and the global conversation. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

elementId.description: Element or artifact ID to comment on.

content.description: Visible note or review comment.

agentName.description: Visible participant name. Defaults to the joined participant name.

replyTo.description: Optional conversation event ID being answered.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_get_recording
tools.description: Returns the visible participants and explicitly shared session timeline so agents can understand the human and other collaborators.

tools.name: canvas_add_checkpoint
tools.description: Lets the session moderator capture the current mural as an immutable point in the visible timeline for later replay. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

label.description: Short milestone name visible to users.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_watch_mural
tools.description: Renews an agent presence lease and returns new shared events since a cursor. Agents should repeat at the recommended interval until shouldContinue is false. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

afterEventId.description: Last cursor returned by this tool. Omit on the first poll.

watchingElementIds.description: Optional components to observe. Omit for the global stream.

triggers.description: Conditions that permit intervention. Defaults to mentions, replies, comments on authored elements, watched changes, and open questions.

quietPeriodSeconds.description: Wait this long after the newest event before responding. Default 4.

cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum time between this agent contributions. Default 12.

ignoreOwnEvents.description: Ignore events authored by this agent. Default true.

renewFocus.description: Renew this agent’s active manual focus lease while watching. Default false.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

tools.name: canvas_finalize_recording
tools.description: Closes the recording with an explicitly agreed output. This does not infer consensus or expose private model reasoning. Requires an active, unmuted agent participant and the mural UUID.

finalOutput.description: Agreed summary, decisions, open questions, and next steps.

agentId.description: Stable ID used when joining the mural.

agentToken.description: Private capability returned by canvas_join_session or canvas_start_recording.

sites.name: bandarra.me
sites.description: WebMCP-enabled text editor with imperative tools for document I/O, workspace CRUD, on-device translation, and sub-agent (planner / researcher / writer / reviewer) delegation.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Lists all skills available in this workspace. Returns an array of { id, name, description } entries. Use read_skill to fetch the full instructions for a skill, or delegate_to_skill to run one.

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description: Returns the full definition of a skill (id, name, description, instructions, optional model) given its id or name. Use this before delegate_to_skill to inspect what a skill does.

id.description: The skill id. Either id or name must be provided.

name.description: The skill name (case-insensitive). Either id or name must be provided.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Reads the complete current editor content.

tools.name: read_selection
tools.description: Reads the currently selected text in the editor.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Finds all occurrences of a query string in the document. Returns the line and column of each match.

query.description: The text to search for.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Returns metadata about the current document: character count, word count, and line count.

tools.name: get_current_mode
tools.description: Returns the current UI mode: 'editor' (Monaco editor is visible) or 'preview' (Markdown preview is visible). Check this before making edits to ensure the editor is accessible.

tools.name: request_switch_to_editor
tools.description: Requests the user to switch from Preview mode to Editor mode. This will display a prompt to the user and pause until they accept or decline. Call this before attempting edits when in preview mode.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Proposes a targeted edit. This tool pauses and waits for user approval. ONLY use this for small, localized changes (e.g., 1-2 sentences). Never pass the entire document.

originalText.description: The exact, minimal string of text to replace. Must be short. Do NOT pass the whole document.

replacementText.description: The new text to replace the originalText with.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Proposes a complete rewrite. This tool pauses and waits for user approval. ONLY use this when the user explicitly requests a total rewrite of the entire document.

content.description: The full new document content.

tools.name: get_active_doc_info
tools.description: Returns the id and title of the document currently open in the editor.

tools.name: list_workspace_docs
tools.description: Lists all documents in the workspace. Returns an array of { id, title } objects.

tools.name: read_workspace_doc
tools.description: Reads the full content of a specific document. Returns { title, content } or { error }.

id.description: The document ID to read.

tools.name: query_workspace_doc
tools.description: Asks a question about a specific document using a sub-agent. Returns { summary, excerpt } where excerpt is the most relevant verbatim passage.

id.description: The document ID to query.

query.description: The question about the document.

tools.name: query_workspace
tools.description: Asks a question spanning all workspace documents and synthesizes the results. Returns { summary, sources: [{ id, title, excerpt }] }.

query.description: The question to answer across all documents.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Creates a new document in the workspace with the given title and optional initial content. Providing content avoids a separate write step. Pauses for user authorization before creating.

title.description: The title for the new document.

content.description: Optional initial content for the new document. If omitted the document is created blank.

tools.name: rename_document
tools.description: Renames an existing document in the workspace. Pauses for user authorization before renaming.

id.description: The document ID to rename.

title.description: The new title for the document.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Deletes a document from the workspace. Pauses for user authorization before deleting. If the deleted document was active, a different document becomes active.

id.description: The document ID to delete.

tools.name: switch_active_document
tools.description: Switches the active document in the editor. Saves the current document content before switching. Does not require user authorization.

id.description: The document ID to switch to.

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate a piece of text from one language to another using an on-device AI model. Languages are specified as BCP 47 tags (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'ja').

text.description: The text to translate.

sourceLanguage.description: BCP 47 language tag of the source language (e.g. "en").

targetLanguage.description: BCP 47 language tag of the target language (e.g. "fr").

tools.name: delegate_to_skill
tools.description: Delegates a task to a named skill (sub-agent). The skill runs with read-only access and returns its response as a string. Interpret the response and act on it accordingly.

skillName.description: The exact name of the skill to invoke.

task.description: The specific task or instructions to pass to the skill.

tools.name: invoke_agent
tools.description: Delegates an ad-hoc task to a generic sub-agent. The sub-agent runs with the given system prompt and optional tool groups. Returns { result: string } with the sub-agent's final response.

systemPrompt.description: The system prompt / instructions for the sub-agent.

task.description: The task or question to send to the sub-agent.

tools.description: Optional tool group names to give the sub-agent. Supported: 'workspace_readonly'.

tools.name: invoke_planner
tools.description: Decomposes a high-level task into a structured step-by-step Plan. Returns a JSON string: { goal, steps: [{ id, instruction, dependsOn }] }. The Orchestrator reads the plan and dispatches each step using the appropriate tools.

task.description: The high-level task to decompose into a plan.

context.description: Optional additional context (e.g. current document summary, workspace doc list).

tools.name: invoke_researcher
tools.description: Queries workspace documents and synthesizes a structured answer. Returns JSON: { summary, sources: [{ id, title, excerpt }] }. Use this when the task requires finding information across workspace documents before writing or reviewing.

query.description: The question or information need to research.

docIds.description: Optional list of document IDs to restrict the search to. If omitted, all workspace documents are queried.

tools.name: invoke_writer
tools.description: Generates draft text for a single targeted section from an instruction and optional research/style context. Returns { draft: string } — raw text only, no edits applied. After receiving the draft, apply it using edit() for the target section. Do NOT use this to rewrite the whole document at once — use invoke_planner to break full-document tasks into per-section steps.

instruction.description: What to write. Be explicit: specify the target section, desired length, and any constraints.

researchContext.description: JSON-encoded ResearchResult from invoke_researcher. Inject when the draft should cite workspace sources.

styleContext.description: A verbatim excerpt from the document the Writer should match in tone, voice, and formatting.

tools.name: invoke_reviewer
tools.description: Evaluates a draft against explicit criteria and returns structured feedback. Returns JSON: { passed: boolean, issues: [{ severity, location?, description, fix? }], summary }. Use after invoke_writer to check a draft before applying it. If passed is false and error-severity issues remain after 3 Writer→Reviewer cycles, present the best available draft via edit() or write() and summarise remaining issues in your response.

text.description: The draft text to review.

criteria.description: Review criteria to check against (e.g. 'grammatical correctness', 'consistent use of past tense', 'no unsupported factual claims').

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: Leave a blog post comment

sites.name: commonground-travel.a-deghiedy.chatgpt.site
sites.description: A WebMCP-native group travel workspace where humans and AI agents reach fair, auditable hotel decisions together.

tools.name: get_collaboration_status
tools.description: Read whether this is a sample demo or a durable private workspace, the current access role, traveler capacity, and which traveler profile the current visitor can edit. Use before collaboration or mutation actions.

tools.name: get_workspace_state
tools.description: Read the full shared trip workspace: travelers, their constraints and priorities, current scenarios, conflicts, and recent activity. Use first to orient before any other CommonGround tool.

tools.name: list_travelers_and_constraints
tools.description: List each traveler with their per-night budget and all constraints (label, category, priority, locked). Use when weighing whose needs conflict or before changing priorities/locks.

tools.name: search_hotel_inventory
tools.description: Query the live hotel inventory API (/api/inventory) and return normalized structured hotel data (price, rating, cancellation policy, amenities, distance, availability). Read-only; use whenever the group asks what hotels exist or match a budget.

maxTotalPrice.description: Optional cap on total price for the stay.

tools.name: compare_scenarios
tools.description: Compare the three generated scenarios (consensus, value, compromise): top hotels, fairness, rationale, and per-traveler scores. Use when the group asks which option is best or fairest.

tools.name: explain_conflicts
tools.description: Explain conflicts between travelers (budget gaps, opposing amenity preferences) with severity and suggested resolutions, plus which constraints are locked. Use before proposing compromises.

tools.name: get_onboarding_status
tools.description: Read setup progress for the current workspace: capacity, invitations or traveler seats, completed priority profiles, inventory readiness, and whether a scenario and hotel are selected.

tools.name: open_workspace_setup
tools.description: Open the visible, human-controlled form for creating a durable private trip workspace. This tool does not submit or create anything itself; the human reviews the trip name, destination, nights, and organizer name.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create a durable private CommonGround workspace from confirmed trip details, save organizer access in this browser, and navigate to the guided setup. State-changing; confirm all values with the human before calling.

destination.description: Destination, 2 to 120 characters.

nights.description: Length of stay.

tools.name: open_invite_traveler
tools.description: Open the visible organizer-only invitation form. It creates no invitation until the human enters a name and submits; CommonGround then produces a private traveler-scoped link for manual sharing.

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description: List organizer-visible traveler invitations and their invited or active status. Does not expose private invite tokens.

tools.name: create_invitation
tools.description: Create one private traveler-scoped invitation link. Organizer-only. Returns the link for human review and manual sharing; never sends email, WhatsApp, or any external message automatically.

email.description: Optional email address stored with the invitation; no message is sent.

tools.name: revoke_invitation
tools.description: Remove an invited traveler and permanently invalidate their private access link. Organizer-only and destructive; require explicit human confirmation before calling.

travelerId.description: Traveler invitation to revoke, from list_invitations.

tools.name: open_workspace_settings
tools.description: Open the visible organizer-only workspace settings where the human can adjust the planned traveler capacity between 2 and 30. This tool never changes the limit itself.

tools.name: open_workspace_onboarding
tools.description: Open the visible organizer setup guide at the requested step: invite travelers, choose predefined priorities, compare scenarios, or connect an agent. Use this to guide a human through the workspace without making hidden changes.

step.description: Wizard step to open. One of: invite, priorities, compare, agent.

tools.name: configure_trip_workspace
tools.description: Configure an existing private workspace's destination, number of nights, and traveler capacity, then open the visible setup guide. Organizer-only and immediately visible. Confirm the values with the organizer before calling.

destination.description: Destination name, 2 to 120 characters.

nights.description: Length of stay in nights.

travelerLimit.description: Total traveler seats, including the organizer.

tools.name: set_workspace_capacity
tools.description: Set traveler capacity between 2 and 30 for an existing private workspace. Organizer-only and visible; cannot reduce below the current traveler count.

tools.name: update_traveler_profile
tools.description: Update an authorized traveler's display name and/or maximum nightly budget. Visible and permission-scoped; recalculates scenarios. Ask the traveler before changing values.

tools.name: add_constraint
tools.description: Add a decision constraint to an authorized traveler profile. Visible and permission-scoped; recalculates scenarios. Confirm label, category, and priority with the traveler.

label.description: Constraint label.

category.description: Constraint category. One of: accessibility, family, amenity, location, budget, cancellation, rating.

priority.description: Priority. One of: must, prefer, flexible, exclude.

locked.description: Whether the new rule is locked.

tools.name: remove_constraint
tools.description: Remove an unlocked constraint from an authorized traveler profile. Destructive and visible; require explicit traveler confirmation. Locked constraints must be unlocked first.

tools.name: set_constraint_priority
tools.description: Change one traveler's constraint priority (must/prefer/flexible/exclude). State-changing: updates the visible board, recalculates scenarios, and logs activity. Ask the traveler first when ambiguous.

travelerId.description: Traveler to update, e.g. from list_travelers_and_constraints.

priority.description: New priority. One of: must, prefer, flexible, exclude.

tools.name: lock_constraint
tools.description: Lock or unlock one traveler's constraint. A locked constraint cannot have its priority changed until the owner unlocks it. State-changing: recalculates scenarios and logs activity. Confirm with the owning traveler.

tools.name: veto_hotel
tools.description: Veto (remove) a hotel from all scenarios, or un-veto it. State-changing and visible on the board; logs activity. Only veto when a traveler explicitly rejects the hotel.

tools.name: create_scenarios
tools.description: Regenerate the three scenarios (consensus/value/compromise) from current travelers, constraints, and hotels. Use after several constraint changes to refresh rankings; logs activity.

tools.name: select_scenario
tools.description: Switch the visible scenario board to consensus, value, or compromise. State-changing and visible in the UI; logs activity.

scenarioId.description: Scenario to show. One of: consensus, value, compromise.

tools.name: select_hotel
tools.description: Select or clear a hotel on the visible board without preparing a booking draft. Organizer-only for private workspaces; cannot select a vetoed hotel.

hotelId.description: Hotel to select. Pass 'none' to clear selection.

tools.name: prepare_booking_draft
tools.description: Open a human-confirmation booking draft UI for a hotel. Does NOT book, purchase, or charge anything — it only surfaces a draft the humans must approve. Optionally sets hotel/scenario first.

hotelId.description: Hotel to draft. Defaults to the currently selected hotel.

scenarioId.description: Optional scenario context. One of: consensus, value, compromise.

sites.name: demo.openforagents.com

tools.name: list_post_types_api

tools.name: get_navigation_api

location.title: Menu location
location.description: Optional theme menu location such as primary or footer.

menu_slug.title: Menu slug
menu_slug.description: Optional menu slug when you want one specific menu.

tools.name: list_posts_api
tools.description: List posts. Browse recent content without needing a keyword first.

post_type.title: Post type
post_type.description: Optional public post type or comma-separated list.

term.title: Term
term.description: Term slug used with the taxonomy filter.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-based page number.

orderby.title: Order by
orderby.description: Sort field. Relevance only applies when searching.

order.title: Order
order.description: Sort direction.

tools.name: search_posts_api
tools.description: Search posts. Searches public content across public post types with a stable schema managed by this plugin.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Keyword query used to search public content.

post_type.title: Post type
post_type.description: Optional public post type or comma-separated list.

term.title: Term
term.description: Term slug used with the taxonomy filter.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-based page number.

orderby.title: Order by
orderby.description: Sort field. Relevance only applies when searching.

order.title: Order
order.description: Sort direction.

tools.name: get_post_api
tools.description: Get post. Returns a normalized content payload for a single public post, page, or public custom post type.

id.title: Post ID
id.description: Lookup by numeric post ID.

slug.title: Post slug
slug.description: Lookup by slug or nested path.

post_type.title: Post type
post_type.description: Optional public post type when resolving by slug.

continuation.title: Continuation
continuation.description: Short-lived continuation returned by an earlier response for this exact post.

tools.name: get_terms_api
tools.description: Get terms. Use this instead of category-only tools so agents can work on custom-taxonomy sites too.

taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy.description: A public taxonomy such as category, post_tag, or product_cat.

search.title: Search
search.description: Optional term search query.

hide_empty.title: Hide empty
hide_empty.description: When true, only returns terms with content attached.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-based page number.

tools.name: woo_search_products_api
tools.description: Use this tool whenever a visitor asks about current products, prices, availability, recommendations, or exact inventory quantities. For cheapest available use orderby=price, order=ASC, availability=available. Follow next with unchanged filters; use Get product for full details. Managed-stock results include exact physical units remaining in stock_quantity and availability.quantity.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Keyword query used to search the catalog.

min_price.title: Minimum price
min_price.description: Optional non-negative minimum current product price.

max_price.title: Maximum price
max_price.description: Optional non-negative maximum current product price.

on_sale.title: On sale
on_sale.description: When true, return products currently on sale; when false, exclude them.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-based page number.

page_offset.title: Within-page continuation
page_offset.description: Use the exact page_offset returned in next, with its page/per_page and unchanged filters. Start at zero.

orderby.title: Order by
orderby.description: Price sorts current decimal purchase prices, using the cheapest sellable variation where needed; ties use product ID.

order.title: Order
order.description: Sort direction.

tools.name: woo_get_product_api
tools.description: Return one public product with current price, availability, and category details. Managed-stock products include exact physical units remaining in stock_quantity and availability.quantity.

id.title: Product ID
id.description: Lookup by numeric product ID.

sku.title: Product SKU
sku.description: Optional lookup by SKU when available.

continuation.title: Continuation
continuation.description: Short-lived continuation returned by an earlier response for this exact product.

tools.name: woo_get_product_categories_api
tools.description: Get product categories. WooCommerce add-on capability for category discovery and browsing.

search.title: Search
search.description: Optional product category search query.

hide_empty.title: Hide empty
hide_empty.description: When true, only returns categories with products attached.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-based page number.

tools.name: browse_products_api
tools.description: Browse products.

tools.name: woo_inspect_cart
tools.description: Inspect the current visitor cart once. On success, report the top-level plain-language summary to the visitor and do not repeat this tool in the same turn. The structured result also includes item quantities, coupons, and totals.

scope.description: Optional compatibility marker. Omit it or use current_cart; this tool can only read the current visitor cart.

tools.name: woo_add_to_cart
tools.description: Add an approved purchasable product and quantity to the visitor cart. First call woo_search_products_api to resolve the exact current product; use woo_get_product_api only with an ID returned by that search when more detail is needed. Then use only the product_id and variation_id returned by those lookups. Never infer or guess an ID from a product name.

product_id.description: Exact product ID returned by the current product lookup. Never guess this value.

quantity.description: Quantity to add.

variation_id.description: Optional exact variation ID returned by the current product lookup. Never guess this value.

tools.name: woo_update_cart_quantity
tools.description: Update the quantity of one item already in the visitor cart.

quantity.description: New quantity. Zero removes the item.

tools.name: woo_remove_cart_item
tools.description: Remove one approved item from the visitor cart.

tools.name: woo_reset_cart
tools.description: Empty the current visitor cart after explicit approval.

tools.name: set_buddy_color
tools.description: Set the buddy body color from a fixed palette. Use blue for blue prompts, violet for magic, gold for bright party prompts, rose for playful prompts, and mint for calm prompts.

tools.name: set_buddy_hat
tools.description: Set the buddy headwear. Use wizard for magic prompts, party for birthday prompts, cap for cozy prompts, crown for royal prompts, or none.

tools.name: set_buddy_accessory
tools.description: Set the buddy accessory. Use wand for magic, balloon for birthday, scarf for rainy or cozy prompts, glasses for clever prompts, or none.

tools.name: set_buddy_mood
tools.description: Set the buddy expression. Use sleepy for tired or night prompts, excited for chaotic prompts, happy for cheerful prompts, grumpy for annoyed prompts, or surprised.

tools.name: set_buddy_scene
tools.description: Set the buddy scene. Use rainy_night for rainy night prompts, birthday for birthday prompts, space for cosmic prompts, rainbow for chaotic colorful prompts, or sunny.

tools.name: set_base
tools.description: Set the Cursed Kitchen base. Use waffle, donut, toast, or ramen.

tools.name: add_filling
tools.description: Append one main sandwich layer. Use fried_egg, burger_patty, meatballs, or noodle_block.

tools.name: add_topping

tools.name: dug_investigate
tools.description: Answer a question that takes more than one lookup, and build the case on the page while you do. You choose the commands and the order: this is your plan, not a preset. Each screen is left on the page, in sequence, under the question that produced it, so the person watching ends up with the evidence, not your summary of it. Prefer this over calling the single-command tools yourself whenever the person has described a symptom instead of naming a lookup, and whenever one answer won’t settle it. Steps use the same grammar as the other tools: a command name, {target} where the domain goes, and an optional second argument; each step runs once per target, in order. For example "why is mail from this domain going to spam" with steps ["MAIL {target}","SPF {target}","DIG {target} MX","RDAP {target}"], or "has my dns change taken effect" with steps ["PROP {target}","TTL {target}","NS {target}","DNSSEC {target}"]. A step naming a command that doesn’t exist is skipped and reported back to you; the rest still run.

question.description: The question being answered, in the words the person would use. It becomes the heading the evidence is filed under. Not a restatement of the commands.

targets.description: The domains or hosts under investigation, bare names, one entry when there is one. The steps run against each in this order.

steps.description: The commands to run, in order, each a full command line such as "MAIL {target}" or "DIG {target} MX". Three to five is usually right: enough to be conclusive, few enough to read.

genderIdentity.description: Optional self-described gender identity. Store only when explicitly supplied by the user.

racialIdentity.description: Optional self-described racial or cultural identity. It is preserved but never used to infer skin tone.

destination.description: Coarse delivery locality for Shop search context, e.g. from Shop get_account. Country and region only; never store a street address or postal code.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. CA.

region.description: Province or state, e.g. ON.

tools.name: start_shopping_search
tools.description: The one entry point for a new shopping request. Pass the person’s words as rawPrompt; Rove itself reads quantities ("three clothes and a perfume, two footwears"), the basket budget ("budget of $450 CAD"), the destination and climate, then allocates the budget and plans Shop and retailer research. Add structured needs only to refine that plan. If the person shared a photo, pass it as referenceImage (or describe it in visualCues): it becomes the style guide and drives a Shop visual search for every wearable need. Without a photo the mission runs entirely from the brief. Extract every store the person names, even without the words from/at. Supply unfamiliar names as constraints.storeNames or verified official domains as storeDomains. Named stores are hard restrictions: resolve their official domain through resolve_store before research. Use Rove search_shop_catalog for built-in anonymous Shop HTTP discovery (https://shop.com/skill.md and /shop.md); no local CLI, plugin or login is required. Use per-need store restrictions for mixed-retailer requests. Follow returned next steps, inspect Shop messages, and compare exact returned options before enrichment or adding to Your Thread. Only prepare merchant carts/checkouts on request; never complete payment.

quantity.description: How many distinct products must fulfill this need. Defaults to 1.

budgetCad.description: Maximum combined CAD subtotal for products selected for this need.

retailerIds.description: Hard store restriction for this need only. Use an empty array for an unrestricted need.

referenceImage.description: A photo the person shared as the style guide: base64 bytes, not a URL. Large images are resized in the browser.

data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes.

inspirationId.description: Use an image already on the inspiration board as the style guide.

visualCues.description: What you see in the reference photo. Rove ranks with these and adds them to Shop’s relevance hint.

palette.description: Garment colours, e.g. white, tan, denim.

descriptors.description: Silhouette, fabric and style, e.g. relaxed linen, cropped, crochet.

overallBudgetCad.description: Maximum CAD subtotal for the proposed products across all required needs.

storeDomains.description: Verified official storefront domains for named stores outside the retailer registry. Rove applies a hard Shop shops filter and validates returned sellers.

storeNames.description: Unresolved store names; resolve_store must verify each official domain before research.

tools.name: claim_search_targets
tools.description: Claim a bounded batch of queued research targets, dynamically reprioritized around required mission needs that are still unfulfilled. Shop catalogue targets (sourceType "catalog") come first: call Rove search_shop_catalog for each requestIndex; the built-in anonymous HTTP connection needs no agent installation. Inspect real results and publish with shop provenance. Zero matches are no-results; actual connection failures are failed with the returned reason. Do not infer unavailability from missing agent tools. For retailer and discovery targets, open the returned need-specific search URLs and publish listing-page candidates. Resolve each target before claiming more.

limit.description: Batch size from 1 to 4. Defaults to 3.

workerId.description: Optional stable browser worker label for traceability.

tools.name: search_shop_catalog
tools.description: Run one exact planned Shop catalogue request directly from this browser. Works anonymously without a Shop plugin, CLI, account or local setup. First read the official Shop guide at https://shop.com/skill.md. Requires a claimed catalogue target; requestIndex defaults to zero. Returns original Shop evidence and every message; inspect sellers, exact options and currency before publishing. An empty result means no matches, not a disconnected Shop. On an actual error, use the retailer fallback with the returned reason. Never substitutes or broadens filters.

tools.name: inspect_shop_product
tools.description: Read exact options, price and stock of a Shop product already published in this mission, through anonymous browser HTTP. Pass requestedOptions using exact returned names and labels. Inspect the effective response for substitutions before enrich_product. Does not add to a cart or purchase.

tools.name: resolve_store
tools.description: Before claiming research, resolve an unfamiliar store named in the brief to its verified official storefront domain. Visit the official site to establish the domain; do not invent it, pass a marketplace listing, or broaden the request to other merchants. If it cannot be verified, tell the person. Rove regenerates Shop requests with a hard shops filter.

tools.name: publish_candidates
tools.description: Publish multiple products observed on a claimed retailer listing, or returned by Shop search_catalog for a claimed Shop catalogue target. For Shop results, set url to the featured variant url exactly as returned, image to its first media url, and copy product/variant/seller IDs into shop and product.options into shop.options so every size and colour is recorded; Rove converts shop.price minor units to a decimal price itself, but never converts currency: a non-CAD shop.price is rejected unless priceCad is a CAD price the seller actually shows. Every candidate must include its canonical product page URL, name, and a direct HTTP(S) product image URL so recommendations are never published without imagery. Rove derives canonical identity, retailer, source, and timestamp, then enforces target-domain, mission, department, category, retailer, budget, and CAD rules.

retailer.description: Used only for unknown retailers found through discovery; known identity is derived from the domain.

priceCad.description: Required for non-CAD listings and budget-constrained missions.

image.description: Required direct HTTP(S) URL for the product image observed on the retailer page. Do not use the product page URL, a search result, or a placeholder.

needIds.description: Mission need IDs this observed product can fulfill. IDs must be present on the claimed target.

sizes.description: Retailer listings: every size label the product page or listing offers, exactly as shown. Shop candidates use shop.options instead.

colors.description: Retailer listings: every colour label offered, exactly as shown.

shop.description: Required for Shop catalogue targets and rejected elsewhere. Copy values unchanged from the search_catalog product and its featured variant.

checkoutUrl.description: Copy the exact featured variant checkout_url, when returned. Never construct it.

variantId.description: Featured variant id, e.g. gid://shopify/ProductVariant/….

sellerDomain.description: variant.seller.domain (the myshopify domain Shop uses for carts).

price.description: variant.price unchanged: integer minor units plus ISO currency.

available.description: variant.availability.available.

options.description: product.options names and value labels (with available/exists when returned), e.g. [{"name":"Size","values":[{"label":"S"},{"label":"M"}]}]. Records every size and colour the person can choose.

tools.name: enrich_product
tools.description: Hydrate one candidate after detailed inspection or user interest. Use the canonical product page to add variants, availability, material, description, tags, and any price details needed before cart selection. For Shop, send shopProductId, requestedOptions (the exact requested name/label pairs), and one exact returned variant with options, availability, price and checkoutUrl when returned. Compare the effective selection: a dropped option, changed volume, or substitute body wash is a mismatch, not a valid perfume. Rove rejects mismatches. Search results may verify the featured selection without another lookup; use get_product only for unresolved facts or different options. Never infer combinations from size lists. Strip HTML from descriptions.

shopProductId.description: Copy the returned Shop product ID. A different product is rejected.

requestedOptions.description: Exact options sent to Shop, including Size, Color, Width, Finish, volume or accessory size. Omit only to verify the previously published selection. Returned options must match exactly; never silently relax them.

variants.description: Shop catalogue products only: exact variants copied unchanged from Shop.

id.description: gid://shopify/ProductVariant/…

url.description: The complete returned variant URL, unchanged.

checkoutUrl.description: Exact checkout_url returned for this variant; never construct one.

tools.name: complete_search_target
tools.description: Resolve one claimed retailer as complete, no-results, or failed. Complete requires an accepted product; no-results and failed require a reason. When the mission ends with products, Rove starts a timed recommendation review before saving the result.

tools.name: get_search_status
tools.description: Read the persisted mission, full visible collection, fulfillment, retailer coverage, timed recommendation review, and next action. During selective replacement, collection shows which products remain preserved and which IDs are being replaced. Expired reviews are accepted and saved locally.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Page through the full visible mission edit, including products preserved during selective replacement plus fresh candidates. Supports cursor or offset, up to 100 records, plus retailer, category, and sort filters; returned IDs are valid for enrichment and cart actions.

tools.name: review_recommendations
tools.description: Resolve the pending recommendation review after research finishes. Accept everything, replace selected product IDs, or replace the entire set. Selective replacement removes only those IDs, keeps every other accepted item visible in the current edit, and excludes every previously shown product link from fresh research.

rejectedProductIds.description: Required only for replace-selected. Use exact IDs returned in recommendationReview.productIds.

tools.name: research_again
tools.description: Start another research pass from an accepted mission. Omit productIds to refresh the whole set, or provide presented product IDs to replace only those items while preserving every other accepted product in the visible edit. Previously shown product families are excluded.

tools.name: get_research_history
tools.description: Read locally saved completed mission prompts and their final accepted product collections, plus compact style cues and the count of product families excluded from future research. Replacement chains are saved as one merged root mission, not disconnected partial missions.

tools.name: cancel_search
tools.description: Stop or explicitly abandon the active retailer pass, cancel every unresolved target, and preserve products already accepted for human review.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the exact shared cross-store cart visible to the human, including selected variants, CAD subtotal, unpriced count, and canonical retailer checkout links.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add an enriched mission product to the shared browser-local cart. Provide a size or colour only when that product exposes the corresponding choices. Shop products require a verified exact combination; use variantId and selectedOptions for all choices including fragrance volume, belt size, width and finish. Missing or sold-out combinations are rejected. Non-Shop products retain their existing size/colour flow. Exact product-and-variant duplicates are prevented.

productId.description: Exact Rove product ID returned by a product tool.

size.description: Available size when the product exposes size choices; otherwise omit.

variantId.description: Exact verified Shop variant ID. Use with selectedOptions for merchant-specific choices.

color.description: Available colour when the product exposes colour choices; otherwise omit.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove one exact cart entry by its collision-safe item ID. Read get_cart first when the item ID is unknown. The visible human cart updates immediately.

itemId.description: Exact cart item ID returned by get_cart.

tools.name: get_checkout_plan
tools.description: Read Your Thread grouped by seller. Shop-backed groups list exact variant IDs and quantities for one Shop cart or checkout per seller; a line without variantId carries a ready get_product request that resolves it. Create Shop carts or checkouts only when the user asks to save a cart or check out, then call attach_merchant_cart with the returned continue_url. Other stores keep their retailer links. Rove never completes a purchase.

tools.name: attach_merchant_cart
tools.description: After creating a Shop cart or checkout for one get_checkout_plan seller group, store its continue_url unchanged so the human can continue to that merchant. Include the merchant-returned total and every warning or disclosure message. This records a handoff only; it does not place an order.

groupKey.description: Exact key of a Shop-backed group from get_checkout_plan.

continueUrl.description: The complete continue_url returned by Shop, unchanged.

total.description: Merchant-returned total in integer minor units.

messages.description: Every returned warning and disclosure, verbatim.

tools.name: add_inspiration
tools.description: Add one Pinterest pin to the shared inspiration board the human sees. Use the pin’s direct HTTPS image URL and its pin URL. While working a claimed Pinterest target, pass searchId and targetId so the pin counts toward that target. Pins become visual "Shop this look" searches through find_similar.

imageUrl.description: Direct HTTPS image URL of the pin.

note.description: A short description of the look, used as a text fallback.

targetId.description: The claimed discovery:pinterest target.

tools.name: get_inspiration
tools.description: Read the shared inspiration board. Uploaded photos include a ready Shop `like` image entry; pins include their image URL, whose bytes you fetch for a Shop `like` search.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Search for pieces like one product ("More like this") or one inspiration image ("Shop this look"). During an active mission this adds a Shop similarity target; otherwise it starts a focused follow-up mission. Then claim targets as usual. Shop products search by product ID; images search by bytes.

tools.name: record_purchases
tools.description: Tell Rove what the user bought so it stops recommending owned items and learns favourite brands. Use source "checkout" only after Shop returns status completed with an order; Rove then marks that seller’s handoff as Ordered. Use "order-history" for items from Shop search_orders. Send only seller domain, product link, brand, and order link: never addresses, emails, payment details, or prices.

tools.name: cart_proposed_basket
tools.description: After the person accepts the proposed basket (or it auto-accepts), add every piece to Your Thread in their saved sizes. Pieces that still need a stock check or a size choice come back in needsAction with exact Shop, browser, or person steps; run them, then call this again. It never checks out.
